summary: A record list of three apps with an avatar identity, scopes, install count, status chip, created date and a row menu.
use: Admin tables of API apps, integrations or projects where each row needs a name, a few facts, a status and per-row actions.
spec: 3 rows from `apps` (Billing, Support desk, Analytics exporter), each a `<RecordRow>` keyed by `app.id`
`{#snippet identity()}` holds `<Avatar alt={app.name} size="sm" />` and the name in `<strong>`
`<StatusChip status={app.live ? 'success' : 'neutral'} label={app.live ? 'Live' : 'Draft'} />`; `{#snippet actions()}` holds a `<DropdownMenu align="end">` with `Edit` and `Rotate secret` items
